'''Yunaali''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Hammer Squadron (Chiss)|Hammer Squadron]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She flew under callsign "Blue Mother".<ref name="TOR" />
